w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Cancellation is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Agnese opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Wanjiru eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows, and winter is listening. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−1,600 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feas
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Cancellation is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The sky, clearing its throat. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Hoodie. Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Peyton freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Peyton: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Spoiler hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
firstContext: 💧 Wanjiru returns with water: +3 clean.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Spoiler hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
A cart-driver with flour on their sleeves waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Ugly Beast, Big Loud, Big Loud, The Bright Bastard, The Big Beast) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 6× Cattail (720 kcal). You also gather deadfall: 1× branches, 1× bark fiber. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Ivy freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Thornfield, Emberhold, Ashford count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each — 3 grieving fire(s); theirs waits.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛡️ Chris, Stephen, Saiful, Nora and Meera met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Saiful, Nora, Meera are hurt.

🔥 The fire settles. Meera has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph a
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Cush-cush Yam. Climbing vine, white tubers. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: The garden: your untended Burdock drowned in weeds and died. (Six untended days. The garden keeps honest books.)
📻 The System whispers it, for once not delighted: the Finale. Every season needs its climax. This one is yours.

🌪️ THE FINALE struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 77 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/13/7), with 7 wave-4 and 4 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 7 · Forage 17 · Craft 4 · Talk 13 · Explore 52 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Teach it to let go."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ines Duarte ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
